assessment: Chikungunya virus is a very important human pathogen, and research on the architecture of its replication/transcription organelle holds great promise for the development of future therapies. Laurent and colleagues advanced this field by providing pioneering low-resolution 3D structures of the membrane-bound viral protein complex and the viral RNA content of this organelle in situ. In addition, they also assessed the lipid requirements for membrane interaction of the primary viral membrane anchor of this complex, nsP1, in vitro.
